meta.purpose: Candidate scientific contract for DisasterTrace v17; items marked candidate pending V17-03 census and G1 gate
meta.candidate_contribution: A benchmark for distinguishing operational evidence maintenance from probabilistic forecasting skill under real weather-product revisions
meta.statistical_power_note: With only 3 positive labels across 36 checkpoints (8.33%), the paired-diagnostic experiments may be statistically underpowered, making the falsification condition undecidable rather than merely unresolved at current pilot scale. V17-03 census determines whether the underlying evidence-change base rate supports redesigning the sampling/labeling approach.

C01_primary_domain.value_or_spec: H15 airport low-visibility: routine observation visibility threshold events at fixed stations, specifically IEM routine unique-hour reports
open_details: Real transition density in legal pre-target exposure window (V17-03 census)
Label reliability across disputed/unknown provenance chains
Whether sufficient independent weather processes exist in the archive
C01_primary_domain.closing_evidence: V17-03 transition census demonstrates adequate transition coverage within legal checkpoint exposure; disputed/unknown rate acceptable; independent process count sufficient for block inference

value_or_spec.definition: Fixed station, fixed future one-hour window, routine-report visibility threshold event per registered outcome policy iem_routine_unique_hour.v1
value_or_spec.immutability: Target identity frozen before outcome Y resolution; changing station, calendar, or outcome policy creates a new contract version
clarifications_needed: Routine report uniqueness vs correction policy

open_details: Report uniqueness and correction authority rules (F11 concern: input reordering changes Y)
Missing observation fallback policy
One-hour window support vs continuous physical visibility truth
C02_fixed_future_target.closing_evidence: V17-02 implements deterministic, order-invariant outcome resolution with explicit correction authority; missing/conflict outcomes have explicit terminal states

value_or_spec.nesting: Both thresholds are nested (1 km subset of 5 km); they cannot be treated as independent samples
value_or_spec.confirmation_thresholds: Main threshold/indicator family predetermined before confirmation; not selected after observing model performance

open_details: Confirmation-phase main threshold selection (development uses both)
C03_thresholds.closing_evidence: G5 design pre-registers main threshold family with scientific justification, not outcome-driven selection

value_or_spec.checkpoint_grid: T-60 / T-40 / T-20 minutes relative to target window start, equal within-target weights
value_or_spec.time_semantics: Lead time is measured from window start, NOT physical lead time to actual report occurrence
value_or_spec.normalization: sum_k w_jk = 1 for each target j

open_details: Actual achievable checkpoint timing given real TAF/evidence arrival patterns
Whether T-60/T-40/T-20 falls within legal evidence availability for selected targets
C04_scoring_time.closing_evidence: V17-03 verifies checkpoint feasibility against actual evidence receipt times; checkpoint grid achieves intended coverage

value_or_spec.inputs: TAFs, observations, and qualified professional products available at decision time

time_authorities.received_time: Archive receipt timestamp (proxy for operational availability)
time_authorities.available_time: Conservative estimate of when agent could lawfully access

value_or_spec.past_vs_future: Past observations may be used as input; target future outcome Y is hidden until maturation

open_details: Exact derivation of available_time from received_time (lag assumptions)
Cross-window TAF validity applicability rules
Handling of late-arriving evidence that was issued before cutoff
C05_evidence_definition.closing_evidence: V17-01 establishes allow-list and date guards; V17-02 implements lineage with explicit provenance and applicability rules

value_or_spec.first_round: Fixed decision points and evidence exposure schedule
value_or_spec.autonomous_acquisition: Separate experiment design; main experiment uses fixed schedule, not method-selected wake times
value_or_spec.speci_role: SPECI triggers wake but does not replace the main scoring grid

open_details: Whether fixed schedule provides fair comparison across all arms
Autonomous wait/retrieve policy evaluation deferred to Natural track
C06_wake_trigger.closing_evidence: V17-04 implements uniform wake schedule across all method arms; differential wake opportunity logged as covariate

required_outputs.target_probability: Real number in [0,1] for each registered target/threshold
required_outputs.fact_state: Structured citation of currently effective evidence sources
required_outputs.carrier: Agent self-written state summary (for STRUCTURED_STATE arm)

value_or_spec.orthogonality: Fact repair and probability update are orthogonal operations; an agent can repair facts without changing probability and vice versa
value_or_spec.fixed_denominator: Fact slots are predetermined; model cannot select which slots count toward fact compliance

open_details: Exact JSON schema for valid commit
Handling of invalid probability values (NaN, boolean, out of range)
Whether forecast_op must be included in commit identity (F08 concern)
C07_output_format.closing_evidence: V17-04 adds forecast_op to commit identity; validates all field types before hashing; malformed attempts retained in denominator with registered fallback

value_or_spec.effective_state: Uses credible completion/receipt time, unified validation, then effective

state_layers.effective_state: Latest accepted commit's effect on the scored state

value_or_spec.invalid_handling: Invalid or late attempts preserved in denominator; fallback to carry-forward per registered policy
value_or_spec.tie_resolution: Same-moment events have explicit ordering rule; no input-order dependence

open_details: Exact UTC parsing and normalization (F09: regex accepts invalid dates)
Same-UTC ordering tie-break rule
Whether validator and runtime share identical conflict resolution (F10: they differ)
C08_effective_validity_semantics.closing_evidence: V17-04 implements single validated path for all arms; invalid/late attempts retained; validator/runtime policies unified

value_or_spec.source: Independent mature routine observation (ASOS/METAR), with settlement version
value_or_spec.maturation: Wait period before ground truth is considered final

policies.conflict: Genuine replacements use explicit correction/version authority; unresolved disagreements marked missing/conflict rather than selected by row order (F11)
policies.missing: Explicit MISSING terminal state; not forced to negative
policies.late_correction: Post-maturation corrections append new settlement version, do not alter original

open_details: Maturation wait duration
Native correction authority derivation for routine reports
What constitutes semantically identical duplicate (collapse) vs genuine replacement
C09_ground_truth_source.closing_evidence: V17-02 implements order-invariant outcome resolution with explicit correction authority; permutation test verifies input order does not change Y

value_or_spec.registration: Each baseline explicitly registered with: target support, thresholds/units, lead time, visible inputs, training/calibration exposure, model version, missing fallback

product_separation.LAMP_categorical: Native categorical guidance (CIG/VIS/OBV); NOT a calibrated probability
product_separation.derived_probability: Any probability derived from categorical or point forecasts must be separately named and calibrated

value_or_spec.weak_baseline_guard: Comparison against always-zero, naive persistence, or weak FOLLOW alone does not establish meaningful improvement

open_details: LAMP categorical completeness (F06: truncated gzip streams)
Whether qualified probabilistic LAMP products exist in archive
Threshold/support alignment between LAMP categories and H15 targets
C10_professional_forecast_baseline.closing_evidence: QL verifies LAMP stream completeness; V17-06 registers at least one strong qualified baseline with aligned support

value_or_spec.initial_state: Fresh episodes reset self-written state and fixed parameters
value_or_spec.isolation: Development vs confirmation separation enforced; mature Y feedback explicitly logged and gated (default: not open)

arms.FRESH_FULL_PREFIX: Current complete legal evidence prefix + shared tool access; no historical model output; recompute from evidence each time
arms.TRANSCRIPT_STATE: Same prefix + tools; includes historical public judgments, submissions, notes; thinking chain not required to be hidden
arms.STRUCTURED_STATE: Same prefix + tools; model self-written registered-schema state summary

open_details: Schema for STRUCTURED_STATE carrier
Whether TRANSCRIPT_STATE includes all historical model output or only public judgments
Y feedback gating condition per Codex F06/F15 concerns
C11_inter_episode_state.closing_evidence: V17-04 implements three arms with verified equal external prefix; test shows FRESH does not read old output, TRANSCRIPT contains historical model output, STRUCTURED contains self-written carrier

value_or_spec.agent_stop: Agent may issue STOP to cease further computation for target; does not stop weather, concurrent baselines, or remaining scoring points
value_or_spec.effective_state_continuation: Formal state continues per contract even after STOP; carry-forward policy applies
value_or_spec.run_stop: External run termination preserves all attempts and effective states achieved; incomplete run reported with actual coverage

open_details: STOP semantics for in-flight requests
Whether STOP counts as a scored decision or a meta-operation
Cap-hit termination vs explicit STOP distinction
C12_stop_termination.closing_evidence: V17-04 defines STOP semantics; V17-08 implements lifecycle with explicit FAILED/MISSING terminal states for all registration outcomes

amd_cor_vs_probability_change.description: The existence of an AMD/COR product does NOT automatically mean probability must change. These are separately falsifiable propositions.
amd_cor_vs_probability_change.evidence_state_change: An AMD may require updating source citations without changing the probability estimate
amd_cor_vs_probability_change.probability_change: A probability change may be warranted by unchanged evidence (new inference) or may not be warranted by changed evidence (unchanged conclusion)
amd_cor_vs_probability_change.measurement: Fact repair and probability update are tracked and scored independently

downloader_vs_living_system.description: The current pipeline is a downloader/archival system, NOT a living continuously-updating monitoring system
downloader_vs_living_system.current_capability: Historical archive with batch processing; replay with simulated time
downloader_vs_living_system.living_capability: Real-time ingestion, prospective registration before outcomes, maturation-based settlement, continuous task generation
downloader_vs_living_system.c5_requirement: C5 (prospective evaluation) requires demonstrated living capability, not replay

AC1_claim_experiment_mapping.description: Every claim maps to at least one experiment, and every experiment maps back to a claim
AC1_claim_experiment_mapping.verification: See CLAIM_EVIDENCE_MATRIX_v17.md for complete bidirectional mapping

AC2_amd_probability_distinction.description: Contract does not conflate AMD/COR existence with probability-must-change
AC2_amd_probability_distinction.verification: C07_output_format explicitly states orthogonality; critical_distinctions section elaborates

AC3_downloader_living_distinction.description: Contract distinguishes downloader/archival pipeline from living system
AC3_downloader_living_distinction.verification: critical_distinctions section explicitly states current vs living capability; C5 requires demonstrated living capability

AC4_output_no_conflict.description: Output contract contains no internally conflicting fields
AC4_output_no_conflict.verification: C07_output_format defines orthogonal operations; C08 defines explicit state layers; no field can simultaneously mean two things
